cpu.acceptance: All eight CPUs must initialize and show increasing SGI/timer counters, then pass cross-CPU scheduling and TLB tests. CPU_ON success or an IOCPU state alone is insufficient.

memory.software_page_policy: Retain 8796 policy: more than 1 GiB selects 16 KiB software pages; user ABI remains to be qualified.
memory.hypothesis: Only if the entire high region is available to EFI and Kernel.Base modulo 2 MiB is 0x4000: 11 GiB minus 2 MiB. This is not an approved allocation.
memory.required_evidence: Final UEFI descriptors and successful whole-window allocation; CPU address-width/granule report; boot_args and XNU managed totals; high-address CPU and DMA validation.

historical_kernel_policy: Reference only; no copied implementation or hardware-correctness claim.
